title: Summary: Variables and Strings
objective: Store a folder name, then print it, its length, and its upper-case form on three lines.
hint: Store the path in $folder first. Then three Write-Output lines: one with $folder, one with $($folder.Length), and one with $($folder.ToUpper()). Put Folder:, Characters:, and Upper: in front of them, with a space after each.
